failure_observed: The user asked for the skill to be model-agnostic. The rules already referred only to logical roles, but only Claude Code had executable role definitions: on any other model the blind reviewer, grader and readers could not be run, weak models' malformed JSON was fatal, the data policy was documentation only, and a free-tier rate limit crashed the first live run.

components.summary: tools/rce_llm.py: provider layer (openai-compatible, anthropic, gemini, command, manual, mock), data-policy guard, env-only keys, content-free call log, JSON extraction/closer repair/validation retry, transient-error retry.
tools/rce_roles.py: review (packet only), calibrate (resumable, blinded), run-tasks.
templates/models.json, adapters/README.md, adapters/entrypoints/AGENTS.md, adapter notes, SKILL.md and workflow step 18 made model-neutral.
Found by the ASMOS checkpoint-answer round: G4 stale on post-review claims; rejected author statements not 'withheld'.

change.summary: Additive: projects without .rcs/models.json behave exactly as before.

expected_improvement: The skill's single-shot roles run on any model with the same gates and data policy; reviewer quality is measured per model instead of assumed.
possible_regressions: Closer repair could make a truncated reply parse; schema validation still decides whether it is acceptable.
Hosted models used as reviewers see the paper text (packet): allowed only when the host is listed.
